summary: Package the native skier math kernel for macOS arm64, hoist immutable rider body geometry for the reference hip fit, and add a headless paired solver tick benchmark with exact state hashing
areas: Native skier math on macOS arm64

physics.reason: Physical hip fit: native macOS kernel equals the GDScript reference on 3,000 random fits with zero distance, and the 6,000-tick solver state hash is identical with the kernel on and off; model 35, tuning and 120 Hz unchanged. Presentation-only pelvis fitting differs by at most 1.04 mm on random extreme poses (same kernel behaviour Windows already ships).

checks.details: 10,800 checks: 3,000 hip fits bit-identical to RiderBody.reference_fit_hips (max delta 0.0), pelvis fit max 1.04 mm on random extreme poses, joint limit basis max 5e-7. Log artifacts/solver_tick/native/final_skier_fit_native_suite.log
Knee 4,000 checks max 2.4e-7 m; tracker 515,130 checks, max quaternion distance 9.7e-7, velocity 7.3e-5 rad/s, native_available true on macOS.

checks.command: ./godotw --headless --script tests/physics_suite.gd; tests/runtime_suite.gd (run twice: reference path before the dylib existed and with the native kernel active)
checks.details: 56/56 and 192 checks both times. Logs artifacts/solver_tick/suites and artifacts/solver_tick/native.

Anatomy suite passed; animation CPU 72 checks; macOS compatibility 7 checks including explicit macOS kernel configuration, packaged dylib and arm64 selection. tests/pelvis_balance_suite.gd was not usable: pre-existing defect writes to a missing artifacts/steering_response_v22 directory, errors and never quits (unrelated to this change).
State hash 1cc6806dd5c7... identical for reference, hoisted reference and native kernel. Minimum pass us/tick: baseline 349.1/354.3, hoisted reference 333.5/346.1, native kernel 302.0/301.9.

Focused fullscreen Mac probe (FSR 2 default on this branch): animation_tracking 74 -> 24 us/tick, pose_pelvis 72 -> 38 us, pose 430 -> 361 us/frame, animation_tick 315 -> 246 us/tick versus the pre-branch reference; simulation per tick unchanged within noise at 25 FPS (GPU-bound frame). artifacts/mac_probe/result_native_kernel.json

checks.command: Rendered animation with native pelvis/knee/tracking kernels on macOS
checks.details: Paired suites bound the differences; the user's look at skiing animation on the MacBook is pending.

outstanding_acceptance: Windows behaviour is unchanged: the Windows CMake path, DLL and loading are untouched; Windows suites were run headless on macOS only.
Timing is a laptop observation: solver 302 us per tick with the macOS kernel versus 333-346 us reference (6,000 ticks, interleaved minimum passes); the 2-4 percent rider body hoist is separate.
Rendered animation with the native pelvis, knee and tracking kernels on macOS awaits the user's look; paired suites bound the differences (pelvis 1.04 mm, knee 2.4e-7 m, tracking quaternion 9.7e-7).
